core_job: Applies only if the founder keeps NewsBoard (D2). The job: make a 'beat', a word or phrase the user is following. NewsBoard collects every matching story from the 23 BBC News, BBC Sport, NPR and Guardian RSS feeds and keeps it on the phone for 30 days. It shows them as one timeline grouped by day, marking what is new since the user last looked. The user is someone following 2 to 5 long-running stories (e.g. 'measles', 'rent control', 'AI regulation'). It needs no account. Data facts, all checked 2026-10-12: a curl of all 23 feeds returned HTTP 200 and 587 unique dated stories. Using the app's whole-word matching on that data, 'ukraine' matched 26 stories (BBC 6, NPR 6, Guardian 14) and 'trump' matched 44. Baseline on that base: flutter analyze reports 17 info issues; flutter test passes 207 tests.
signature: The Coverage Meter. Each beat gets a 14-day bar chart: one bar per day, split by publisher (BBC, NPR, The Guardian), plus one sentence: 'This week: N stories · the week before: M'. Days before the app was installed come only from what the feeds still listed, so they are drawn in a lighter style and labelled incomplete, not shown as zero. The Desk home screen shows each beat with a small 14-day meter and an 'N new' count. Everything is computed on the device from the app's own 30-day archive; no key, server or account. Competitors were checked only against their App Store descriptions (iTunes Lookup API); web search was not available in this session. Feedly needs an account and puts keyword tracking in its paid Pro tier. Inoreader Pro is a subscription. Google News offers topic following and Full Coverage, and its description does not mention a per-topic coverage chart. Whether any of them has such a chart inside the app is not verified.
must: M1 Headline archive on the device: each fetch adds stories to sqflite (or a file), without duplicates (same link key as today). Kept 30 days, capped at 6,000 stories. Records archiveStartedAt (first fetch on this install). Works offline. Tests cover: union of two fetches, pruning, the cap, data surviving a reopen, and a corrupt store showing an error.

M2 Beats: create, edit and delete a beat with 1-5 'any of' and 0-5 'none of' terms, matched as whole words or phrases (extends articleMatchesFollows). Each beat page is a timeline grouped by day, with a 'New since <time>' divider and an 'N new' count on the Desk. Existing followed topics and hashtags become beats once, on first run. The article screen and the hashtag page get a 'Track as a beat' action.

M3 Coverage Meter (signature): 14-day bars stacked by publisher; days before archiveStartedAt drawn in a lighter style and labelled incomplete; undated stories left out and counted; week-vs-previous-week sentence; tapping a day scrolls the timeline; screen-reader label reads the counts. Desk shows a mini-meter per beat. Tests use a committed fixture of real headlines captured from the feeds, plus golden-string tests for the sentence.

M4 Own layout and navigation: 4 tabs (Desk, Sections, Saved, Settings). The Trending tab, Following tab, For You view, hero card and breaking ticker are removed; tab labels are the app's own strings, not the shared agl_i18n nav keys. Onboarding becomes one screen, 'What story are you following?', with suggestions taken from the live feeds (keywords appearing in headlines from at least two publishers). Tests: onboarding lands on a beat page; exactly 4 tabs.

M5 Depth: search across the whole 30-day archive, filtered by publisher, period (24h/7d/30d) and section, with 'Track as a beat'. Saved gets a filter and an 'Export saved' plain-text share. Each beat gets a 'Share beat digest'. Golden-string tests for both exports, and a test that search finds a story no longer in the latest fetch.

M6 Own identity. Colours: oxblood primary #8C1C13; light background #F7F6F3, ink #1C1B1A, muted #6B6660, rule #D9D5CF; dark background #161412, surface #201D1A, text #EDE8E3, primary #E07A6E; meter colours NPR #2E6E73 and Guardian #B07A1E. Fonts: Libre Franklin and Spectral (both OFL), bundled in the app, with no google_fonts. Shapes: flat rows separated by thin rules, 2px corners, no emoji. CupertinoIcons on iOS. New hand-made icon (five rising bars, light on oxblood). New oxblood splash whose storyboard shasum is not 3f6a9b27. Done when a grep of lib/ finds 0 of the listed Tailwind hex colours.

M7 Honesty: remove dead code (unused house-ad file ad_banner.dart, breaking ticker, AI SUMMARY/KEY FACTS/BREAKING/views blocks, aiSummary/viewCount/isBreaking fields, kSupportedLanguages, the finance/forYou/trending categories). Add more banned phrases to honest_copy_test. Done when greps of lib/ find 0 of 'AI SUMMARY', 'NewsBoard Premium' and RemoteConfig reads.

M8 Empty, error and offline states with copy written for this app: Desk with no beats, a beat with no matches, all feeds failed, offline with an archive (banner), Saved empty (not 'Nothing saved yet'), search with no hits. One widget test per state; the offline test uses a fake client that throws SocketException.

M9 Proven: flutter analyze reports 'No issues found!' (the 17 baseline infos fixed); all tests pass, at least the baseline 207 plus the new ones, none deleted or skipped. Update the ads placement test rather than deleting it. Rewrite the store screenshot test to use live feeds and beats typed on a fresh install. Commits limited to mobile/lib, test, integration_test, assets, pubspec, LaunchScreen, Assets.xcassets and android res; never fastlane/ or Podfile.lock. Launch on a simulator and look at the screenshots.
